messages:
Priya: Heads-up — Sandstone-6B onboarded to canary yesterday. Early evals show weird numeric formatting (e.g., "1.0e+03" instead of "1000") in tabular outputs and a ~60ms latency spike on 1-token requests.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: sandstone-6b v1.0 -> us-east-1 (pool: canary-small)

Dylan: saw that on the eval dashboard. Also noticed increased repetition on short prompts (2-4 tokens). Saved sample ids in #sandeval: 1042,1047.

Sophie: tagging as priority P1 for now. We should run smoke with both FP16 and 4-bit quant to see if quant changed formatting behavior.

Alex: quick idea — tokenizer mismatch? Did we use new tokenizer build? Run `python tools/tokenize_check.py --model sandstone-6b --sample samples/short_prompts.jsonl`

Priya: good call. @Alex the tokenizer in container is v2.1.2, but our reference is v2.0. Put that on the checklist.

Dylan: repro steps I'll run now: `scripts/run_smoke.sh sandstone-6b --quant 4bit --batch 1 --seq 16 --save-logs /tmp/sandstone-smoke.log`

Sophie: checklist so far:
- [ ] Reproduce formatting on local eval
- [ ] Compare outputs FP16 vs 4-bit
- [ ] Tokenizer version diff
- [ ] Latency microbench for 1-token vs 32-token
- [ ] KV-cache sanity (repetition)
- [ ] Rollback plan if regression

Priya: adding ownership: Dylan -> reproduce + logs, Alex -> tokenizer/packaging, Sophie -> perf microbench, me -> rollback & customer comms

Dylan: quick log snippet (showing numeric format):
```
Output: "price": "1.0e+03"
Expected: "1000"
```
Looks like model emits scientific notation tokens when formatting numbers.

Alex: if it's model-side generation tokens, quant could've changed output distribution. I'll run a tf32/fp16 compare and check generation sampling temp/beam configs.

Sophie: for perf — run `perf/latency_probe --model sandstone-6b --seq 1,4,32 --runs 500` and drop results in the thread.

Priya: thanks — if we confirm quant-induced regression, schedule a rollback to v0.9 host weights and open a follow-up for quant pipeline tuning. Keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
